# Selected projects

This page summarises the technical questions addressed by selected projects. Links to dedicated repositories, demos, and reports will be added when those artefacts are publicly available and ready for independent review.

## LLM hallucination evaluation benchmark

**Goal**

Compare approaches to detecting unsupported or hallucinated content in language-model outputs using an evaluation protocol that makes comparisons interpretable.

**Technical work**

- Integration of multiple fact-checking and evaluation systems
- Metric calculation and aggregation from predictions
- Threshold analysis and trade-offs between metrics
- Streamlit visualisation of benchmark results and errors
- Modular code and tests for calculation components

**What it demonstrates**

Evaluation engineering: defining labels and units of analysis, checking metric validity, and distinguishing supported conclusions from claims the data cannot justify.

**Publication status**

The technical scope is identified. A public repository, shareable datasets, full protocol, and numerical results must be verified before links or results are published.

## LLM Wiki — building a source-grounded knowledge base

**Goal**

Turn documentary sources into a structured, searchable, maintainable knowledge base while preserving traceability to source material.

**Technical work**

- Source ingestion and organisation
- Generation of knowledge pages from documents
- Structural validation and consistency checks
- Search across generated knowledge
- Automation and integration of checks into the development workflow

**What it demonstrates**

Knowledge engineering for LLM-based systems: provenance, validation, maintainability, and treating generated content as an engineering artefact rather than trusting generation alone.

**Publication status**

The project is being improved. A public version will be linked when its architecture, limitations, documentation, and reproduction instructions are ready for independent review.
